svg.aria-label: Skills: Languages: C / C++, Python, JavaScript, HTML + CSS, R, Linux scripting; ML & vision: TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, BioBERT, Bi-LSTM, DINOv2, GNN / Transformers, CLIP + FAISS, OpenCV, Scikit-learn; DevOps & observability: ELK Stack, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, UiPath, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, GitHub; Cloud: Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, AWS, Firebase; Databases & data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, Spark, Kafka; Frameworks & tools: Django, React.js, VS Code, Ignition, Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau, RStudio, Blender; Security & robotics: Blockchain, Lattice-based crypto, ORB-SLAM3, Jetson Orin Nano; Coursework: Data Structures & Algorithms, IoT, Cloud Computing, AWS; Soft skills: Problem solving, Self-learning, Rapid prototyping, Communication, Adaptability
